jelleestone.bio: Etobicoke-born rapper Jelleestone, born David Carty, is a veteran of Canadian hip-hop whose career grew from Toronto's late-1990s scene into major-label releases and international collaborations.

jemeni.bio: Grenada-born, Toronto-based artist Jemeni is a hip-hop poet, singer, writer, broadcaster and community worker whose career spans music, radio, television and cultural advocacy.

joey stylez.bio: Saskatchewan First Nations-Métis singer and rapper Joey Stylez blends hip-hop with pop and country influences while using his career to mentor Indigenous artists and support youth communities.

jon vinyl.bio: Toronto R&B singer Jon Vinyl writes vulnerable, nostalgia-heavy soul about relationships and young adulthood, pairing intimate vocals with soft guitars and atmospheric synth production.

junia t.bio: Toronto rapper, producer and DJ Junia-T is a multidisciplinary Canadian hip-hop artist whose solo work, production and touring collaborations helped make Studio Monk a Polaris Music Prize longlisted album.

junia-t.bio: Toronto rapper, producer and DJ Junia-T is a multidisciplinary Canadian hip-hop artist whose solo work, production and touring collaborations helped make Studio Monk a Polaris Music Prize longlisted album.

julIy black.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Jully Black is a Juno-winning R&B artist whose powerful vocals, songwriting and long-running career have earned her the nickname Canada's Queen of R&B.

k. forest.bio: Toronto singer, songwriter and producer K. Forest, born Kashief Hanson, makes atmospheric R&B and hip-hop and has built an independent catalogue alongside production and television-placement work.

kardinal offishall.bio: Toronto rapper, songwriter, producer, DJ and music executive Kardinal Offishall is a foundational figure in Canadian hip-hop, known for blending rap with reggae and dancehall influences.

kellylee evans.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter Kellylee Evans is a Juno-winning vocalist whose improvisational style moves fluidly through jazz, soul, pop and hip-hop.

keshia chanté.bio: Ottawa-born Canadian singer and television host Keshia Chanté began releasing R&B and pop as a teenager, becoming one of Canada's youngest Juno Award winners and a long-running media personality.

keys n krates.bio: Toronto trio Keys N Krates combines live drums, keyboards and DJing in sample-driven electronic music that moves across house, hip-hop, R&B, pop and club production.

keysha freshh.bio: Toronto rapper and songwriter Keysha Freshh is a longtime Canadian hip-hop artist known for sharp lyricism, a career that began in childhood and her work with the all-women group The Sorority.

koriass.bio: Québec rapper Koriass is a leading voice in francophone Canadian hip-hop whose career grew from online battles and independent releases into acclaimed albums, major awards and festival stages.

loud luxury.bio: Canadian dance duo Loud Luxury, formed by Andrew Fedyk and Joe De Pace while attending Western University, pairs house and pop production with high-energy touring and globally successful singles.
